title: Braised Sweetcorn with Jamaican Seasoning
description: A flavorful and tender Japanese-inspired sweetcorn dish with a twist of Jamaican heat.
instructions: Husk the sweetcorn and remove the silk.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, Jamaican seasoning, and sugar.
Add the sweetcorn to the bowl and toss to coat.
Transfer the sweetcorn to a baking dish and add water.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the sweetcorn is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
